# Set an appointment deposit you can explain.

> Free appointment deposit calculator for salons, trainers, tutors, photographers, and other service businesses. Set a deposit, see the balance due, check whether it pays for itself against your no-show rate, and draft your policy.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
